body: I hesitated for an unbearable moment before turning away from the stray dog. Its eyes were pleading, its tail flicking nervously as I realized my mistake in approaching so closely. The urge to retreat was overwhelming, but I forced myself to look at it without judgment. Instead, I focused on the distant camera pointing towards me, hoping whoever was recording would be sympathetic.
